verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a banking-as-a-service platform with a dashboard and APIs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out; the items cover customer, account, card, payment, KYC and webhook APIs only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
